run_autoresearch_cli: run the autoresearch CLI to launch an interactive supervisor agent for optimizing a data pipeline
parse_args_autoresearch: parse command line arguments for the autoresearch CLI including workdir, agent, and pipeline options
build_engine_command: build the engine command list with all CLI flags and options for the autoresearch workflow
build_supervisor_prompt: build the supervisor prompt by loading prompt directories and merging with launch context
split_workdir_and_request: split positional CLI arguments into a workdir path and a free-form user request string
